marketingRemarks.marketingRemark: Welcome to the Haven at Stone Ridge West! This spacious 1,623 sq. ft. townhome offers 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and an attached 2-car garage with the perfect blend of comfort and modern design. The open-concept main level features a kitchen overlooking the dining and living areas, creating an ideal space for everyday living. Upstairs, you'll find a generous primary suite with a walk-in closet and private bath, two additional bedrooms, a small loft, convenient upstairs laundry, and plenty of storage. Enjoy a private backyard with low-maintenance living and NO HOA. Conveniently located just minutes from Highway 99, downtown Merced, shopping, dining, schools, and the Merced Fairgrounds. Contact the sales office today to learn about current incentives and available homes!

schoolReviews.review: I have 2 students here. The one senior and one freshman. I like that it is the type of school where most students know each other from their younger days and yet, they have been welcoming to students like mine, who are transplants. Parents seem to be engaged, FFA seems great and there are lots of programs, clubs and pathways for students to explore.

This is an amazing campus to work at. I feel supported by both administration and parents, which is not always the case at other schools. I have some of the best kids in the district in my classes and for the most part, they all work hard and do their best. This is a wonderful school!!!

Ambitious: Above 50%
